title: Combat Rubber Reconnaissance Craft (CRRC) Coxswain (MGySgt to Pvt) FMOS, DC PP&O
raw_text:
10. MOS 8020, Combat Rubber Reconnaissance Craft (CRRC) Coxswain (MGySgt to
Pvt) FMOS, DC PP&O

    a. Summary. The Combat Rubber Reconnaissance Craft (CRRC) Coxswain is
responsible for the safety and conduct of the boat team and the safe
operation, handling, launch, recovery and maintenance of combat rubber
reconnaissance Craft (CRRC) and its associated equipment, components and SL-3
items.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must have WS-I water survival qualification.

            (2) Must have red/green color vision and visual acuity.

       c.   Requirements.

            (1) A Marine must have completed one of the following courses:

                (a) Marine Special Operations School.

                (b) Basic Reconnaissance Course (BRC) (M10AHK2) at SOI-W.

                (c) 2D Expeditionary Operations Training Group (EOTG) Course
(M0381KB).

            (d) 3D EOTG Combat Rubber Reconnaissance Craft Coxswain Skills
Course (M2281KA).

            (e) Combat Rubber Reconnaissance Craft Coxswain Skills Course
(N3081K1) at Expeditionary Warfare Training Group, Pacific (EWTGPAC).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference (e), Infantry Training and Readiness Manual.

    e. Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code.
Motorboat Operators 53-5022.

       f.   Related Military Skill.   None.
